d:
Bharat ke sansdiy itihas men ab tak char bar sansad ka shitkalin satr nahin bulaya gaya hai. aapatkal, lokasbha ka samay se pahle bhang hona, indira gandhi ki hatya aur kovid-19 mahamari iski pramukh vajhen rahin. kya 2026 men bhi shitkalin satr tal sakta hai? janie iske pichhe ki vajah aur sansad ke purane udaharna.
Thank you for watching our video!
